scenes.name: NINETEEN POINTS
lines: Take the sphere x squared plus y squared plus z squared equals 867.
取球面 x² + y² + z² = 867。
Keep only whole-number points with no negative coordinate: there are exactly nineteen.
只留坐标全为非负整数的点：恰好十九个。
Choosing this shell is a modelling choice. After that, everything on it is hard arithmetic.
选这颗球壳是一个模型选择；选定之后，它上面的一切都是硬算术。

scenes.name: ONE POLE, SIX ORBITS
lines: Cycle the coordinates: x to y, y to z, z back to x.
把坐标轮换一下：x 变 y，y 变 z，z 回到 x。
One point stays put: the pole, seventeen, seventeen, seventeen.
只有一个点纹丝不动：极点 (17, 17, 17)。
The other eighteen form six orbits of three, from the outer rim to the inner core.
其余十八个点组成六条三点轨道，从外层一直排到内层核心。

scenes.name: 135 EDGES
lines: Join two points when their squared distance is at most 804.
两点的平方距离不超过 804，就连一条边。
Of the 171 pairs, 135 survive; the 36 longest chords are dropped.
171 个点对里留下 135 条；最长的 36 条弦被剔除。
Those edges close up 529 triangles.
这些边围出 529 个三角面。
The degrees add up to 270, twice 135, as the handshake rule demands.
度数加起来是 270，正好是 135 的两倍，与握手引理分毫不差。

scenes.name: 23 LENGTHS
lines: The 135 edges come in only 23 different squared lengths.
135 条边只有 23 种不同的平方弦长。
Each length j gives an arc angle theta, with cosine one minus j over 1734.
每个弦长 j 给出一个弧角 θ，其余弦为 1 − j/1734。
Could these angles hide a rational relation that locks some clocks together?
这些角之间会不会藏着有理关系，让几只时钟锁死在一起？
Each angle lives in an imaginary quadratic field, and a Galois argument keeps different fields apart.
每个角落在一个虚二次域里；伽罗瓦论证说明，不同域的角彼此绑不到一起。

scenes.name: ONE RELATION
lines: The 23 angles sit in 21 fields: 12, 68 and 136 share the field of root minus two.
Multiply the numbers for 12 and 68, and you get exactly the one for 136.
把 12 与 68 对应的数相乘，恰好得到 136 的那个数。
The sphere shows why: three points sit in order on one great circle, so the arcs simply add.
球面上一看便知：三个点依次落在同一条大圆上，弧长直接相加。
One relation among 23 angles leaves exactly 22 rationally independent frequencies.
23 个角之间只有这一条关系，于是恰好留下 22 个有理独立频率。

scenes.name: TWO LEAN PILLARS
lines: Two results here are checked by the Lean kernel.
这里有两条结论由 Lean 内核检验。
First, for nonzero integer quaternions, the triad x y-bar z is associative up to rescaling.
其一：对非零整四元数，三元积 (x ȳ) z 在射线等价下满足结合律。
And the rational overlap kappa survives passing both arguments through the same triad.
并且两个自变量经过同一个三元迁移后，有理重叠 κ 保持不变。
Second, if a continuous shell density h casts the one-axis shadow f, then h is minus two r f prime.
其二：若连续的球壳密度 h 投下单轴影子 f，则 h = −2r f′。

scenes.name: 21, NOT 18
lines: Last, the plain graph Laplacian of the 135 edges.
最后，看那 135 条边的普通图拉普拉斯。
Over the reals its rank is 18: nineteen vectors in eighteen dimensions reproduce it.
在实数上它的秩是 18：十九个向量放进十八维就能复现它。
Demand rational coordinates, and a two-adic Hasse obstruction rules out 18, 19 and 20.
一旦要求坐标全为有理数，2-进哈塞障碍便封死了 18、19、20 维。
The minimum is 21: three dimensions the real numbers never see.
最小维数是 21：多出三个实数看不见的维度。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter one.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第一章
